rv.q: This unapologetically thunderous musical is a mighty showcase for the songwriting talents of Jim Steinman.
The choreography still makes it look like a 1990s aerobics video, all arm-led, as if they’re trying to swat flies.
A Leggers review Jim Steinman’s Bat Out of Hell The Musical at the Dominion Theatre in London’s West End. Will it be Break A Leg? It!
